title: kithctl: TLS ClientConfig rebuilt on every JMAP request
description: kithctl/watch.rs:249,474 — build_tls_connector() is called inside watch_once() and jmap_post() on every invocation. ClientConfig::builder() with PinnedCertVerifier is non-trivial: allocates RustCrypto state. Should be constructed once and passed as Arc<TlsConnector> to avoid per-request overhead and certificate re-parsing.
